# sently

> Runtime-agnostic messaging library for Node.js, Bun, Deno, and Cloudflare Workers.
> Channel-first email, SMS, WhatsApp, and Web Push. Zero runtime dependencies. ESM only.
> Version: see package.json (currently 0.9.x). Full handbook: site/content/docs (bun run site:dev).

## Model

Apps use channel senders — not vendor SDKs. Providers are transports under those senders.

| Channel | Sender import | Contract |
|---------|---------------|----------|
| Email | `sently/mailer` or `sently/smtp` | `Transport` |
| SMS | `sently/sms` | `SmsTransport` |
| WhatsApp | `sently/whatsapp` | `WhatsAppTransport` |
| Push | `sently/push` | `PushTransport` |

Vendor extras (OTP, etc.) live on the concrete transport class only.

## Install

```
bun add sently
```

## Quick examples

### Email (HTTP)

```ts
import { createMailer } from "sently/mailer"
import { ResendTransport } from "sently/transports/resend"

const mailer = await createMailer({
  transport: new ResendTransport({ apiKey: process.env.RESEND_API_KEY! }),
})
await mailer.send({ from, to, subject, html })
```

### SMS

```ts
import { createSmsSender } from "sently/sms"
import { TwilioSmsTransport } from "sently/transports/twilio-sms"

const sms = createSmsSender({
  transport: new TwilioSmsTransport({ accountSid, authToken }),
})
await sms.send({ to: "+15551234567", body: "Hello", from: "+15557654321" })
```

### WhatsApp

```ts
import { createWhatsAppSender } from "sently/whatsapp"
import { WhatsAppCloudTransport } from "sently/transports/whatsapp-cloud"

const wa = createWhatsAppSender({
  transport: new WhatsAppCloudTransport({ accessToken, phoneNumberId }),
})
await wa.send({ to: "15551234567", template: { name: "welcome", language: "en_US" } })
```

### Web Push

```ts
import { createPushSender } from "sently/push"
import { WebPushTransport } from "sently/transports/webpush"

const push = createPushSender({
  transport: new WebPushTransport({
    vapidPublicKey,
    vapidPrivateKey,
    subject: "mailto:you@example.com",
  }),
})
await push.send({ subscription, title: "Hi", body: "Hello" })
```

## Transports (exported)

Email: smtp, resend, sendgrid, postmark, mailgun, ses, brevo, mailersend, plunk, sparkpost, mailtrap, loops, cloudflare-email, sndr, taqnyat-mail, preview, retry, fallback, weighted-fallback

SMS: twilio-sms, taqnyat-sms, msegat

WhatsApp: whatsapp-cloud, taqnyat-whatsapp

Push: webpush

Also: `sently/idempotency`, `sently/webhooks`, `sently/dkim`, `sently/auth/oauth2`, `sently/pool`, `sently/plugins/template`, `sently/react`, `sently/adapters/*`

## Docs for agents

- Repo contract: AGENTS.md
- Handbook MDX: site/content/docs/
- Live site routes when running: /llms.txt, /llms-full.txt, /llms.mdx/docs/...

## Prefer

- Channel senders + transport subpaths for tree-shaking
- Stable SentlyError codes from providers
- No inventing APIs not in package.json exports
